## Exploring complex text corpora

I'm beginning to apply syntactic analysis in particular in these projects:

- a [digital Complutensian polyglot Bible](https://neelsmith.github.io/digital-complutensian/): digital resources for both experts and novices, supporting aligned multilingual reading. 
- the **Homer Multitext project**:  a personal site about how I work with the Homer Multitext project’s digital archive


## Working with citable images

- [iiif-cite](https://github.com/neelsmith/iiif-cite): a single-page web app to work with IIIF image collections using stable CITE2 URNs


## Some hobby coding

Annotate media files:

- [imageviewer](https://github.com/neelsmith/imageviewer): light-table and image browsing apps in self-contained HTML files
- [audioplayer](https://github.com/neelsmith/audioplayer): a self-contained HTML file to browse and play audio files in a local file system

Calendrically scheduled readings:

- [rcl](https://github.com/neelsmith/rcl): data resources and a web app for reading in the Revised Common Lectionary.
- [parshah](https://github.com/neelsmith/parshah): data resources and a web app for the weekly parshah and haftarah readings.
